WildSpark 2.2.14 fixes gathering requirements for English herb names even before the client has cached item data. Minimap node tooltips show the node name, required skill level, and explicit profession requirement, color-coded by the player's current skill. Both custom minimap markers and minimap-owned Blizzard tooltips are covered.

Rare-spawn reference timers remain included and clearly labeled as unverified for WoW Forever; locally learned and peer-shared observations remain primary.
